findings: 1,549,090 public pull requests in 2026-10 clearly came from coding agents, +177% on a year earlier.
That is 4.7% of all public pull requests, against 6.8% a year earlier, because all public pull requests grew from 8.2M to 32.9M.
Agents working under a person's account look human here, and they may explain part of that wider growth, but this data cannot show it.
